paragraphs.text: A continuation of the former history, from the rearing of the tabernacle to the numbering of the people; being the history of one month only.
Whereby they were led to Christ; as the apostle showeth in that excellent Epistle to the Hebrews, which is a just commentary upon this book.
A whole burnt offering, {Heb 10:6} purporting whole Christ suffering for us, {Isa 53:12} and our sacrificing our whole selves to him as a "reasonable service." {Rom 12:1}
As acknowledging his own guilt, and transferring the same upon Christ, resting upon him with full assurance of faith, handfasting us unto him.
paragraphs.anchor: And he shall put his hand.

paragraphs.text: The priest shall kill it: for it was death for any man to offer his own sacrifice. So it is still for any to come to God, otherwise than in and by Christ.
paragraphs.anchor: And he shall kill the bullock.

paragraphs.text: To show the grievousness of our Saviour’s sufferings; the cruel usage of his suffering saints; {Mic 3:3 Heb 11:35} and the duty of all that have benefit by him, to flay off the old man with his deceitful lusts, {Eph 4:22} dealing thereby as the Turk dealt by him that betrayed the Rhodes. He presented unto him his promised wife and portion; but with it told him that he would not have a Christian to be his son-in-law; and therefore caused his baptized skin, as he called it, to be flayed off, and him to be cast into a bed strawed with salt, that he might get a new skin. {a} See Mar 9:49.
paragraphs.anchor: And he shall flay the burntoffering.

paragraphs.text: That fire from heaven {Lev 9:24} - which the heathens apishly imitated in their vestal fire - typing either the scorching wrath of God seizing upon Christ, or the ardent love of Christ to his, and their zeal for him.
Showing that ministers must rightly divide, and dispose the word of God, {2Ti 2:15} and evidently set forth Christ crucified. {Gal 3:1}
Shadowing Christ’s perfect purity {Heb 7:26} and our entire sanctification. {Eze 26:19 Heb 10:22}

The burning and broiling of the beasts could yield no sweet savour; but thereto was added wine, oil, and incense, by God’s appointment, and then there was a savour of rest in it. Our prayers, as from us, would never please; but as indited by the Spirit, and presented by Christ, they are highly accepted in heaven.
paragraphs.anchor: Of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

paragraphs.text: But "cursed be the deceiver that hath in his flock a male, and voweth and sacrificeth unto God a corrupt thing." {Mal 1:14}
Not eastward, as the heathen sacrifices: or to note the obscurity of the legal ceremonies.
paragraphs.anchor: On the side of the altar northward.

paragraphs.text: Old turtles and young pigeons are the best: God must have the very best of the best, as being best worthy.

Or, Pinch it with his nail, that the blood might go out, without separating it from the rest of the body. This prefigured the death of Christ without either breaking a bone or dividing the Godhead from the manhood; as also the skill that should be in ministers, to cut or divide aright the word of truth.

Or, The maw with the filth thereof - that is, the guts which receive the filth sent unto them from the maw - was plucked out, and the blood strained at the side of the altar. This signified those clots of blood wrung from our Saviour before his oblation upon the cross.
That the inward part might be laid on the fire. See Psa 51:18-19 Mar 12:33.
